title: Citrix NetScaler: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can run commands on it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 41 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access. The severity score is critical (9.5). The exploit prediction score is 82%.

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 30, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
